en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate, multi‑storey historicist building with a central entrance and two corner pavilions. In front of the building is a formal garden with paths, lawns, and trees, enclosed by a wrought‑iron fence and stone pillars along a broad street. The caption at the bottom identifies the city as Pécs and names the institution as the 'Zrínyi Miklós' royal secondary school boarding institute. The reverse side is an unused divided‑back postcard with printed address lines, the note 'Minden jog fenntartva.' and the publisher's imprint 'Barasits Budapest'.
